decision_space.encoding: unique zero-based indices into a frozen Poisson candidate set
decision_space.minimum_candidate_spacing: three rotor diameters, reduced by one percent only if a site cannot contain its declared number of turbines
decision_space.candidate_seed: 42 plus the sum of the UTF-8 bytes in the case identifier
decision_space.candidate_snapshot_policy: generate locally, validate, and freeze SHA-256; do not redistribute the upstream source assets

evaluator.wind_direction_unit: radians converted from the supplied degree sectors
evaluator.wind_distribution: 12 directions by 4 speeds with direction-major joint probability
evaluator.thrust_coefficient: piecewise-linear interpolation of the supplied Ct curve with endpoint clamping
evaluator.power_curve: MATLAB-compatible not-a-knot cubic spline over the supplied 4.2-MW turbine table
evaluator.cable_routing: sector rotation, balanced groups, per-group minimum spanning tree, and subtree-load cable assignment
evaluator.physical_fes_definition: one completed layout evaluation including cable routing, every joint wind state, AEP, capacity factor, and LCOE

pooling_rule: canonical repaired-profile results and source-replay results are separate experiment families
